marketplace_slcsp.long_description: Monthly premium for the second-lowest-cost Silver plan (SLCSP) available on the ACA marketplace, computed for a 30-year-old non-tobacco-using individual. The SLCSP is the benchmark plan used to determine premium tax credit eligibility. Computed from CMS Public Use Files (PUFs) for both Federally-Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) and State-Based Exchange (SBE) states. County-level premiums are derived by matching plans to rating areas via CMS Service Area PUFs.

sources.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Public Use Files

marketplace_lcbp.long_description: Monthly premium for the lowest-cost Bronze plan (LCBP) available on the ACA marketplace, computed for a 30-year-old non-tobacco-using individual. Bronze plans have lower premiums but higher cost-sharing than Silver plans. Computed from CMS Public Use Files (PUFs) for both Federally-Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) and State-Based Exchange (SBE) states. County-level premiums are derived by matching plans to rating areas via CMS Service Area PUFs.
marketplace_lcbp.short_description: Monthly premium ($) for the lowest-cost Bronze plan on the ACA marketplace for a 30-year-old non-tobacco-using individual

sources.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Public Use Files
